persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

messages.text: Could you turn all five attached pictures—the dog pic, the surprised cat pic, the two friends pic, the woman's portrait, and the lake pic—into a reel for me? I thought it would be nice to do something with these pictures instead of just leaving them sitting around. What I mean is one 8-second vertical 9:16 reel using the whole set. Make it fun, and you can pick the vibe, the order, the editing style, any music, sound effects or voice, and any captions, wording or language. I'm curious to see what you come up with because I don't really have a particular vision in mind.
